title: Male God, Your Persona Has Collapsed!
altTitles: Male God, Your Image Has Been Ruined!
My Male God, Your Character Has Collapsed!
My Male God, Your Persona Has Collapsed!
Nan Shen, Ni Ren She Beng Le!
Nán Shén, Nǐ Rén Shè Bēng Le!
description: Reborn into his college days, Zhou Yuwen knows how important it is to maintain his image. In this new life, he wants to be seen as mature, talented, and responsible, especially when it comes to relationships. However, his carefully constructed persona begins to fall apart when his ex-wife from his previous life appears and insists that they should remarry. As Zhou Yuwen tries to escape his complicated romantic past, a chaotic series of misunderstandings and relationships unfolds around him.
author: Chongqing Yuanman Animation
